title: Code of Conduct
text: Contributors users expected communicate respectfully, document technical claims, distinguish reproducible numerical evidence conjecture. Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory conduct accepted. Project maintainers may edit remove contributions violate standards. Methodological disagreement welcome. Reports identify estimator, critical-value convention, calibration mode, software version, reproducible example whenever possible.

title: Contributing
text: Please open issue proposing change covariance conventions, critical values, certification status semantics. Pull requests : include focused testthat coverage; preserve frozen Julia reference fixtures; pass R CMD check Windows, macOS, Linux; distinguish verified witnesses local-search candidates; never interpret numerical search failure global infeasibility.

title: RobustSandwichRV 0.5.0
text: Added version-pinned GitHub installation instructions runnable demo("quick-start") practitioner-oriented explanation table. Added fixed Bartlett quadratic-spectral HAC, including article aliases HAC_Bartlett_L4 HAC_QS_BW5, frozen row ordering explicit bandwidths. Added raw two-way CR0/CR1 via TWCR0_raw, TWCR1_raw rule constructor. CR1 preserves separate component corrections actual residual df. Extended three current RV estimands, benchmark deletion refits, independent covariance evaluation validate_sandwich_reference() rules. Added continuous signed-form lower envelope indefinite operators signed-quadratic direction optimization/root finding. Nonpositive target variances rejected, PSD repair. Full current-article validation now covers 112 cases estimators.

title: RobustSandwichRV 0.2.0
text: Added rv_sand() unrestricted scalar-index loss robustness, analytical continuous-envelope lower bound independently refitted uppers. Added rv_cal() restoring-increment strength-dependent profile calibration current manuscript, allowing every positive ratio cap. Direct fixed caps also supported. Added rv_benchmarks() retaining signed deletion increments, common-chi corrections, partial R-squared values binding controls. Empty, incomplete complete-zero pools distinguished. Blocks rank-normalized new increment calibration; profile requires scalar benchmarks. Added sandwich_rv() four-row practitioner table common test cutoff. Retained legacy point symmetric-band APIs compatibility.

title: RobustSandwichRV 0.1.0
text: Initial pure-R implementation. Added classical, HC0, HC1, CR0, CR1 scalar-confounder evaluation. Added protected-first, diagonal-first, full point-conditioned workflows. Added benchmark-bounded calibration certified lower upper bounds. Added scalar rank-normalized grouped observed-control benchmarks. Added explicit full-regression witness validation nested-band reuse. Added two-direction reduction arbitrary omitted-confounder blocks. Added frozen cross-language numerical fixtures, sensemakr comparison, sandwich covariance validation.
